azure-devops-visual-studio-subscribers-i.title: Visual Studio subscribers do not need a paid Azure DevOps license
azure-devops-visual-studio-subscribers-i.body: This estimate bills more than the 5 free Basic users. Anyone on the team who has an eligible Visual Studio subscription is detected at sign-in and gets Basic access (Enterprise subscribers also get Test Plans) at no extra charge, so remove them from the paid count before buying licenses.

citation.quote: There's no extra charge for users with a Visual Studio subscription.
